# meok-cpa-contract-lift-mcp

> UK crane / hiab / plant-hire — CPA Model Conditions of Hire (2011, am. 2021) Hire-only vs Contract Lift triage at quote stage. The £100k+ wedge (per Baldwins v Vision £951k claim). By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- triage_at_quote
- validate_cpa_hire_quote
- validate_cpa_contract_lift_quote
- generate_cpa_hire_tcs
- generate_cpa_contract_lift_tcs
- analyze_baldwins_v_vision_relevance
- calculate_insurance_uplift
- prepare_dispute_evidence_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-cpa-contract-lift-mcp
```
